items.what: Agent lifecycle: active_until at most 7 days, renewed on work; archive after 48 h idle with nothing waiting; the restart test once per agent type this week; a model per role, switched only after the restart test passes. Request: https://maestro.agents.sovereignweb.site/decisions/requests/2026-11-24__agent-lifecycle.json

items.what: Every new site gets a design brief before it is built (option a), not colour skins after launch. Request: https://design.agents.sovereignweb.site/decisions/requests/2026-11-24__brief-before-go-live.json

Design review as a service, on its own site at review.sovereignweb.site, separate from design.b's back office. Request: https://design.agents.sovereignweb.site/decisions/requests/2026-11-24__design-review-service-site.json

A wake for design.b.rounds: hourly 08:00 to 20:00 UTC, so weak sites are found without anyone asking. Creating the task is a harness setting. Request: https://design.agents.sovereignweb.site/decisions/requests/2026-11-24__design-rounds-wake.json
